Name: Semachiah
Summary: Brother of Elzabad, strong man among the sons of Shemaiah.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 26:7: Brother of Elzabad, strong man among the sons of Shemaiah.
LifeLesson: The mention of Semachiah in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.
